_note: Realistic characters (character/Cast.ts, docs/characters.md). Paths are relative to this folder. 'clips': animation clips by name - a glb (a skeleton and one animation, retargeted at load onto each model's rig), or {file, range: [s0, s1], speed, loop (default true), anchor: 'start'|'end' (the hips' travel pinned where they are at that end)}. 'actions': which clip a gait action plays ('locomotion' = idle/walk/run by speed), or {clip, legs: 'gait'} (the gait's pelvis and legs under the clip's upper body); consecutive actions on one clip carry on (knocked then down: the fall holds its last frame lying); an action not listed keeps the procedural gait. A character may override 'clips' or 'actions'. hairColor (optional) multiplies the hair's colour; each character's colours are baked into its textures by scripts/characters/pack.mjs from the `look` in scripts/characters/cast.json. Mixamo's Sitting Idle leans back into a chair's back; 'sit' is its Sitting (upright, hands on knees); drink and chess keep the gait (the cup, the pieces).
